name: 采购与外部供应商的集成 (2EJ)
name_en: Integration of Procurement with External Suppliers (2EJ)
description_en_html:
Overview

For purchasing organizations whose suppliers use traditional data exchange protocols like electronic data interchange (EDI), or in two-tier scenarios, where subsidiaries are on SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, this scope item provides a set of robust application programming interfaces (APIs) to simplify and automate exchanging procurement documents and their follow-on messages.

The following documents and functions are supported:

Procurement Process:

- Create, change, cancel purchase order (outbound message)

- Receive purchase order confirmation (inbound message)

- Receive Advance Shipping Notification (ASN, inbound delivery message)

- Receive supplier invoice (inbound message)

Return Process:

- Create return purchase order (outbound message)

- Receive return purchase order confirmation (inbound message)

- Receive supplier invoice: Credit Memo (inbound message)

The Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) messaging protocol is supported.

You can enable B2B integration with the corresponding Integration of Sales with External Buyer (2EL) scope item.

Key Process Flow

  • Create, change, or cancel purchase order
  • Send purchase order to supplier
  • Receive purchase order confirmation from supplier (optional)
  • Receive advance shipping notification from supplier and process inbound delivery (optional)
  • Receive invoice or credit memo from supplier
  • Perform customer return process

Business Benefits

  • Experience higher degree of automation in exchanging procurement documents with suppliers
  • Reduce time and manual efforts in corresponding with suppliers
  • Increase productivity, performance, and work satisfaction of procurement professionals and accounts payable accountants
  • Save costs for paper, postage, mailing, records management
  • Enable higher degrees of scalability with process efficiency gains
description_zh_html:
概览

对于供应商使用电子数据互换 (EDI) 等传统数据交换协议，或在两层场景中（即子公司位于 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition）的采购组织而言，此范围项目提供了一组强大的应用程序编程接口 (API)，以简化和自动化交换采购凭证及其后续消息。

支持以下凭证和功能：

采购流程：

- 创建、更改、取消采购订单（出库消息）

- 接收采购订单确认（入库消息）

- 接收提前装运通知（ASN，入库交货消息）

- 接收供应商发票（入库消息）

退货流程：

- 创建退货采购订单（出库消息）

- 接收退货采购订单确认（入库消息）

- 接收供应商发票：贷项凭证（入库消息）

支持简单对象访问协议 (SOAP) 消息传递协议。

您可以通过相应的销售与外部采购商的集成 (2EL) 范围项目启用 B2B 集成。

关键流程流

  • 创建、更改或取消采购订单
  • 向供应商发送采购订单
  • 接收来自供应商的采购订单确认（可选）
  • 从供应商接收提前装运通知并处理入库交货（可选）
  • 从供应商处接收发票或贷项凭证
  • 执行客户退货流程

业务优势

  • 在与供应商交换采购凭证时，体验更高的自动化程度
  • 减少与供应商对应的时间和手动工作量
  • 提高采购专家和应付账款会计人员的生产力、绩效和工作满意度
  • 节省纸张、邮费、邮寄、记录管理成本
  • 提高流程效率，提高可扩展性
